stem: A test of a new product page gives p = 0.04 for the difference in conversion. A manager says: "So there is a 96% chance the new page works." Which statement is correct?

options.text: The manager is right: 1 minus the p-value is the chance that the new page really does work
There is a 4% chance that the null hypothesis of no effect is true
If the page had no effect, a gap at least this large would appear about 4% of the time
The new page raises conversion by about 4% relative, the size the p-value shows
